job.title: Financial Accountant

  • Support the budgeting and forecasting process, including cost analysis and financial modelling.
  • Manage accounts payable activities, including invoice processing, reconciliations and payment runs.
  • Process and reconcile payroll, ensuring accuracy and compliance with relevant legislation.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations, cash flow reporting and treasury-related activities.

job.title: Senior Financial Accountant
job.description:
About the Company
Quinn Allan is proud to partner with a well-established international organisation operating within the manufacturing, wholesale and distribution sector who is seeking a Senior Financial Accountant to join their team. With operations spanning sourcing, production, warehousing and national distribution, the business services a diverse customer base across multiple channels throughout Australia. The organisation has built a strong market position through a combination of quality products, long-standing customer relationships and a commitment to excellence.
Operating within a complex, multi-site environment, the business is focused on driving improved financial performance, enhancing reporting capability and strengthening commercial decision-making as it enters its next phase of growth.

The Opportunity
An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Senior Financial Accountant to join the business during a significant period of transformation and improvement. The initial focus of the role will be on strengthening financial processes, improving reporting accuracy and enhancing controls across the finance function. This position will suit someone who enjoys working hands-on with the numbers, identifying issues, solving problems and establishing robust financial foundations.
As the finance function continues to mature, the role will broaden into a more commercially focused position, supporting strategic decision-making through insightful analysis and business partnering.

The Role
Reporting to the CFO and working closely with senior finance leadership, key responsibilities will initially include:
  • Ownership of month-end reporting and financial close activities
  • Preparation and review of monthly balance sheet reconciliations
  • Strengthening financial controls and balance sheet integrity
  • Development and maintenance of accurate cash flow forecasts
  • Investigation and resolution of historical accounting issues and discrepancies
  • Enhancing the quality, consistency and timeliness of financial reporting
  • Supporting budgeting, forecasting and planning processes
  • Monitoring inventory, margins, working capital and cost performance
  • Identifying opportunities to improve systems, processes and reporting
  • Supporting finance transformation and business improvement initiatives
Over time, the role will evolve to include:
  • Financial modelling and scenario analysis
  • Profitability, cost and margin analysis
  • Providing commercial insights to support operational decision-making
  • Business partnering across operations, procurement, sales and supply chain functions
  • Preparation of business cases and performance improvement recommendations
  • Supporting strategic planning and growth initiatives
About You
For success in this role, you will be a technically strong accountant with experience of establishing sound processes and controls.  
You will bring:
  • CA or CPA qualification
  • Strong financial accounting and month-end reporting experience
  • Proven experience managing balance sheet reconciliations and financial controls
  • Advanced cash flow forecasting capability
  • The ability to identify problems, analyse root causes and implement practical solutions
  • Strong analytical skills, including advanced Excel capability
  • Experience working with ERP and accounting systems
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with a continuous improvement mindset
Experience within manufacturing, FMCG, wholesale, distribution or another inventory-based environment will be highly regarded. Exposure to finance transformation, systems implementation or business integration projects would also be advantageous.

To be successful in this role, you will be a technically strong and hands-on finance professional who enjoys operating in a collaborative, high-accountability environment. You will be comfortable balancing strategic responsibilities with day-to-day financial management while partnering effectively with a broad range of stakeholders.

You will have:
• CA or CPA qualification
• Minimum 5 years' experience in accounting and finance roles
• Strong financial and management accounting capability
• Experience managing month-end reporting, budgeting and forecasting processes
• Strong tax knowledge and understanding of compliance obligations
• Advanced Excel skills and experience using Xero or similar accounting systems
• Proven leadership experience with the ability to coach and develop team members
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• A proactive, adaptable and solutions-focused approach
• Experience within investments, superannuation or member-based organisations will be highly regarded but not essential

Benefits

job.title: Senior Contracts & Invoicing Officer
job.description:
About the Company
Our client is a leading technology consulting business with a strong reputation for delivering innovative solutions to some of Australia's best-known organisations. With a collaborative, people-first culture and a continued focus on growth, they offer a fast-paced and supportive environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, build strong relationships, and make a genuine impact.
 

About the Role
We're looking for a Contracts & Billing Administrator to join our team and help keep our contract and billing processes running smoothly.
Working closely with Finance, Sales, Delivery, and Account teams, you'll be responsible for setting up customer contracts, managing invoicing and billing schedules, resolving billing queries, and ensuring all records are maintained accurately. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of administration, finance operations, and stakeholder engagement in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Be Doing
Contracts & Administration
  • Set up and maintain customer contracts and project information within Workday.
  • Manage contract details, commercial terms, invoicing schedules, and billing triggers.
  • Ensure all supporting documentation is complete, accurate, and properly filed.
  • Coordinate contract approvals and updates with internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor contract milestones and changes that may impact invoicing.
Billing & Invoicing
  • Prepare and issue invoices in line with customer agreements and billing schedules.
  • Support billing and revenue recognition activities.
  • Review timesheets, milestone approvals, and supporting documentation to ensure accurate billing.
  • Process invoice adjustments, credit notes, and rebills when required.
  • Assist with month-end billing and reconciliation activities.
  • Investigate and resolve invoicing queries in a timely manner.
Accounts Payable Support
  • Assist with supplier invoicing, supplier setup, purchase orders, and payment runs.
  • Provide general support to the Finance team across accounts payable activities.
Building Relationships
  • Be a key point of contact for billing and contract-related questions.
  • Work closely with Finance, Sales, Delivery, and Account teams to resolve issues and meet deadlines.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders and escalate issues when required.
  • Contribute ideas and improvements to streamline processes and enhance accuracy.
About You
You'll likely have experience in a similar contracts, billing, or finance administration role and enjoy working in a collaborative environment where attention to detail matters.
You'll bring:
  • Experience in contract administration and/or billing and invoicing.
  • Exposure to accounts payable processes.
  • Experience using Workday or a similar ERP system.
  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach.
  • Confidence working with a range of stakeholders across the business.
